newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Fire says to issue 45 million new shares.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Fire says to issue 45 million new shares.

text.p: Nissan Fire & Marine Insurance Co Ltd said on Friday that it plans to issue up to 45 million new shares.
It said the payment date would be February 17.

The company said in a statement that the new shares would be sold through a public offering in the domestic and overseas markets except the United States. It said it would later decide how many new shares would be sold domestically.
As of end-December, Nissan's outstanding shares totalled 204.18 million, it said.
